text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, relative neutropenia and lymphopenia, elevated erythrocytes, ferritin, D-dimer, LDH, INR, and basophils, with low glucose. These findings suggest possible acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory processes, with risk for coagulopathy. Consider infection, inflammation, or hematologic disorder; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
